scope: Chapter 12 now proves global decreasing smooth strictly admissible approximation of bounded canonical upper-test admissible potentials, for a strictly positive Hermitian background and 2<=m<n. Four new proofs establish decreasing smooth majorants, the upper-test penalty squeeze, a direct recursive decreasing admissible approximation, and equality of smooth-obstacle envelopes over continuous and bounded competitors. Successive obstacles lie below the preceding approximation; their positive gap is fixed before choosing the penalty parameter. The construction precedes continuous products and avoids an envelope/product dependency cycle.
